subject: Boreal Ignite — pilot top-up + launch sweetener (exec approval needed)
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@borealignite.com>
To: naomi.feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@borealignite.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot kick-off questions

Hi Naomi —

Quick follow-up from our side after the demo: the pilot is going well but our usage is spiking because we added two new internal teams. We have one ask — can Redwood provide an additional pilot credit top-up and a short launch sweetener to help cover the spike while we finalize the procurement cadence? Specifically:

- +50,000 free inference credits to cover incremental token usage for the next 30 days
- 3-week extension on the pilot end date (from Dec 1 -> Dec 22)
- A one-time 20% starter discount on the first month of committed Dedicated capacity if we sign within 60 days

If this is possible, we can commit to an update call next week and fast-track legal. Attaching current SOW and usage export.

Appreciate it — Samantha

Attachments: Boreal_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf), boreal_usage_aug_oct.csv (text/csv)

From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@borealignite.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot kick-off questions — Boreal request for top-up + discount (need exec OK)

Folks — forwarding Boreal's ask. Quick summary: they want +50k free credits, a 3-week extension, and a one-time 20% starter discount if they convert within 60 days. This is a Strategic SMB with high likelihood to expand; usage shows steady growth and three teams are actively experimenting.

My recommendation: approve the credit top-up and pilot extension now (low cost, keeps momentum), and reserve the 20% starter discount as an exec-authorized concession tied to a 6-month commit at a minimum MRR threshold. Requesting exec sign-off on the combined package (credits + discount) so legal/finance can prepare a short amendment and DocuSign.

Key points for approval:
- Revenue upside: projected 6–9x ARR in 12 months if conversion happens as expected (notes in HubSpot deal).
- Controls: credits are one-time and non-recurring; discount applied only to first month following conversion and conditional on commit.
- Risk: minimal — pilot margins absorb top-up.

Can you please weigh in by EOD Thursday? I can send a templated amendment if you OK.

Thanks — Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: naomi.feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@borealignite.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot kick-off questions — Boreal request for top-up + discount (need exec OK)

Naomi — thanks for the context and the numbers. I support the credit top-up + extension today. We should treat the 20% starter discount as a conditional executive concession requiring sign-off from Marissa (finance lead) and a documented commit (6 months minimum, with a minimum $12k ARR). If they don't hit the commit we should claw back via a one-time billing correction clause.

Couple of asks before final approve:
- Can you add expected new monthly token run-rate post-top-up (ballpark)?
- Please confirm the proposed wording for the discount clause (one-time 20% on month 1 only; cannot be stacked with other promotional offers).

If Marissa signs off, I can give a quick OK and you can issue the amendment.

Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: naomi.feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@borealignite.com>, Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@borealignite.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot kick-off questions — Boreal request for top-up + discount (exec approval given with conditions)

Thanks for the thread and the clear ask. Approve the following with the conditions below:

Approved:
- One-time credit top-up: 50,000 free inference credits (non-recurring).
- Pilot extension: 3 weeks (new end date Dec 22, 2026).
- Conditional starter discount: 20% off month 1 of Dedicated capacity, applied only if Boreal signs a 6-month commitment at >= $12,000 ARR within 60 days of pilot end.

Conditions / Legal language to include:
1) Credits explicitly expire at pilot extension end date and do not carry forward.
2) Discount is a single-use concession; cannot be combined with other partner discounts or marketplace promos.
3) Commit verification clause: payment for month 1 must be charged and cleared to validate discount; if commit not met within 60 days, the discount offer is void and no retroactive credit will be issued.
4) Redwood to reserve right to rescind discount if usage patterns indicate abuse (clearly defined in amendment).

Naomi — please prepare an amendment draft (short, single-page) and routing for DocuSign. Include the SOW attachment and the usage CSV we received. We'll route the final DocuSign to Samantha and Tom.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: Boreal_SOW_v2.pdf, boreal_usage_aug_oct.csv
